item.stem:
Aarav looks at the diagram. Points $B$, $O$ and $A$ lie on one straight line, and ray $OC$ meets line $BA$ at $O$. The marked angle at $O$ between $OC$ and $OA$ is $90^{\circ}$.

Which claim about the figure is correct?

options.A: Ray $OC$ is perpendicular to line $BA$, and $\angle COA$ is a right angle.
options.B: $\angle BOA$ is a right angle because ray $OC$ is drawn.
options.C: Every angle drawn on line $BA$ must be a straight angle.
options.D: Angle $\angle COA$ is right because the letter $C$ is printed highest on the page.
